children: Mexico’s economic activity rose 3.4% year over year in July 2026, beating forecasts of 2.5% and accelerating from a 2.8% increase in June.
The tertiary sector led growth, expanding 4.0%, driven by wholesale trade (13%), cultural, sports, entertainment, and recreational services (8.0%), and government activities (4.6%).
The primary sector grew 3.4%, supported by a 2.7% increase in livestock production.
The secondary sector expanded 2.7%, as mining and manufacturing output both increased 1.6%, while construction activity grew 7.3%.
On a monthly basis, economic activity grew 0.8% after falling 0.1% in the previous month.

title: Mexico Economic Activity Growth Beats Forecasts
